title: Create a generic catalog
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create a generic catalog.

## Introduction
Content and service-based businesses require a unique approach to showcase their offerings. The generic catalog is a specialized catalog type built specifically for advertisers globally who have itemized, non-commerce product or service inventories. It provides a tailored feed structure, ad format, geo-targeting logic, and optimization path designed to highlight service-oriented offerings.The generic catalog is ideal for businesses operating in:
- Education courses
- Local services
- Clinics and healthcare services
- Live events
- Professional and financial services
- Real estate
- Telecom and utility
- Comics and other service-like or non-commerce offerings

## Prerequisites

- You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-started-guide/v1.3) for details.
  - To create a generic catalog, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/api-reference/v1.3) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/app-permissions/v1.3) to find out how to configure permissions.

## Steps

To set up a generic catalog:

1. Create a generic catalog using [/catalog/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-catalog/v1.3) by setting `catalog_type` to `GENERIC`.
2. Upload products to the catalog using [/catalog/product/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-json-schema/v1.3) (JSON schema), [/catalog/product/file/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-file-url/v1.3) (CSV feed template), or [/catalog/feed/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-feed/v1.3)(online data feed schedule).
  - To learn about the detailed parameters and available values for CSV feed templates, see [Generic catalog CSV feed parameters](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/generic-catalog-csv-feed-parameters/v1.3).
  - To learn about the detailed parameters and available values for JSON payloads, see [`products` object array parameters for generic catalogs](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-json-schema/v1.3#anchor-0-2-1-9).
3. Check the product handling results.
  - For CSV feed and JSON schema, use [/catalog/product/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-product-handling-log/v1.3).
    - Pass in the `feed_log_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `error_affected_products` in the response is not null, examine the issue details and return to Step 2 to reupload the product.
  - For online feed, use [/catalog/feed/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-log-of-a-feed/v1.3).
    - Pass in the `feed_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `error_count` in the response is not 0, examine your online feed and return to Step 2 to reupload the product.
4. Confirm that the catalog contains one or more available catalog products via the value of `approved` returned from [/catalog/overview/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-overview-of-a-catalog/v1.3). Only available products can be delivered in your ads. The minimum number of required available catalog products varies based on your desired ad format:
  - If you want to use the Single Video or Catalog Video ad format, ensure the catalog contains at least one available catalog product.
  - If you want to use the Catalog Carousel ad format, ensure the catalog contains at least two available catalog products.
5. (Optional) Create a product set using [/catalog/set/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-product-set-by-conditions/v1.3). If you want to have products selected from a product set, creating a product set is necessary. Otherwise, you can skip this step.
6. (Optional) Invite members to Business Center and grant the Admin permission using [/bc/member/invite/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/invite-members-to-a-bc/v1.3). You can also choose `advertiser_role` that you want to assign to the members invited.
7. (Optional) Share a catalog with members and grant catalog management access using [/bc/asset/assign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/assign-an-asset/v1.3). Make sure to specify `CATALOG` in the `asset_type` field and `ADMIN` in the `catalog_role` field.

## Next steps

Once your generic catalog is set up, you can use it to create Upgraded Smart+ Generic Catalog Ads. Choose the guide that matches your advertising objective:

- Sales objective with sales destination as Website: See [Create Upgraded Smart+ Web Generic Catalog Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-web-generic-catalog-ads/v1.3).
- Sales objective with sales destination as App: See [Create Upgraded Smart+ Catalog Ads for App](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-catalog-ads-for-app/v1.3).
- Sales objective with sales destination as Website and app: See [Create Upgraded Smart+ Catalog Ads with Website and App Optimization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-catalog-ads-with-website-and-app-optimization/v1.3).
- Lead Generation objective: See [Create Upgraded Smart+ Lead Generic Catalog Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-lead-generic-catalog-ads/v1.3).
